Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted the unverified assumption that André Hunebelle directed “The Gallant Lords of Bois-Doré” and proceeded to research his death place without first confirming the director. The actual director is Bernard Borderie, whose place of death is Paris; anchoring on Hunebelle led to the incorrect final answer (Nice instead of Paris).
